name: Supergood
description: A cheerful identity for a maker community. A chunky check, minty teal, and sunny vintage typography turn workshops and small victories into something worth celebrating.
heading: bricolage
rules: The check keeps its chunky rectangular construction.
Use a checkerboard only as a border or a dedicated graphic surface.
Headlines should sound like an invitation from a friend.

system.concept: Screenprinted checkerboards, chunky approval geometry, workshop-object illustrations, and warm heavy grotesk lettering. A vintage community language that feels sincere and active.
headline: Make something.
Make it supergood.
features: A welcoming place to turn a thought into something real.
Different people, useful skills, and good company.
A community built around doing, sharing, and showing up.
system.layoutNote: Mint centered hero, heavy warm grotesk, checker border, and sunny maker illustration. Bottle-green 2px outlines and optimistic, rounded invitation buttons.
